Scale: the plate is square and about 340 px across in the image. It is probably a side plate of roughly 22 cm, so 1 cm is about 15 px.

Brussels sprouts: the pile is about 150 px by 120 px, or roughly 10 cm by 8 cm. It holds about 12 sprouts, each around 15 g when roasted, so roughly 150 g in total. Some of them are small, so I'll estimate 130 g.

Roasted potatoes: the cubes are about 2 cm each and there are roughly 20 of them. A 2 cm cube weighs about 8 cm³ × 1.05 ≈ 8.5 g raw, and a bit more with the whole potato pieces. At about 10 g each, that gives about 200 g. Many cubes are smaller, so I'll estimate 180 g.
